# `/clarify`

> Resolve ambiguities in a feature spec before planning. Auto-detects the feature if no argument given.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/clarify.md — do not edit -->

Resolves ambiguities in a spec, one question at a time, and edits the spec in place.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/clarify [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | `spec.md`, `PRD.md`, `DESIGN.md` |
| **Writes** | `spec.md` |
| **Gates** | At most five questions per run; recommended default offered for each. |
| **Next** | `/plan` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(git:*), Read, Edit, Grep, Glob, EnterWorktree` |
